brief.text: Berkshire Hathaway’s $136,382,789 allocation to Lennar Corp (LEN) represents the single largest purchase on the dashboard, vastly outsizing all other activity combined. In group purchases, Bank Bradesco (BBD) pulled in an exceptional 21 distinct insiders totaling $28,952,210, dwarfing standard clusters such as Dick'S Sporting Goods (DKS) with six buyers at $5,088,794 and Agree Realty (ADC) with three at $4,142,871. Closed-end funds also formed a common thread across both tables, drawing cluster buys in GAM and RWAY alongside individual additions in DLY and DHF.
